query: Which credible causal-identification strategies (exogenous shocks, DiD, synthetic control, IV, matching) are feasible in Jordan and what comparator cases or instruments are available?

response.query: Which credible causal-identification strategies (exogenous shocks, DiD, synthetic control, IV, matching) are feasible in Jordan and what comparator cases or instruments are available?
response.answer: In Jordan, feasible causal-identification strategies include DiD and IV, with potential comparators from neighboring countries and synthetic control using regional data. Exogenous shocks and matching are also applicable, depending on available data.
